title: a16z Podcast: Knowledge Builds Technology and Technology Builds Knowledge -- with Joel Mokyr

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: But what really triggered the Industrial Revolution?
reader_summary.overview: But what really triggered the Industrial Revolution? Why did it take place in Europe and spread beyond? It has to do with a competitive, open market of ideas — a transnational “Republic of Letters”, not unlike the early days of the blogosphere.

key_points.text: And the conditions that created it (virtual networks, open access science, weak ties.
Despite fears of what new tech may bring, the alternative to not innovating is stagnation — “not doing it is worse”.
So how do we then measure that growth?
